name: Versioning, Compatibility & Deprecation
description: Versioning, Compatibility & Deprecation standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-VERSIONING applies.

rules.title: Use semantic versions for externally consumed contracts and packages
rules.detail: Breaking changes increment major, backward-compatible features increment minor, and backward-compatible fixes increment patch unless a documented ecosystem-specific scheme applies.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use semantic versions for externally consumed contracts and packages.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use semantic versions for externally consumed contracts and packages.

rules.title: Define compatibility windows before introducing breaking changes
rules.detail: Document supported client/server/database version combinations and the minimum migration window for consumers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define compatibility windows before introducing breaking changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define compatibility windows before introducing breaking changes.

rules.title: Deprecate before removal
rules.detail: Mark deprecated fields/endpoints/features, communicate alternatives and removal date, measure remaining usage where possible, then remove only after the policy window.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Deprecate before removal.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Deprecate before removal.

rules.title: Prefer additive contract evolution
rules.detail: Add optional fields/endpoints/events before removing or changing existing semantics; avoid meaning changes under the same version.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prefer additive contract evolution.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prefer additive contract evolution.

rules.title: Version persisted or replayable data deliberately
rules.detail: Schemas, event payloads, caches and serialized data that survive deployments require compatibility or migration strategy.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Version persisted or replayable data deliberately.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Version persisted or replayable data deliberately.

rules.title: Record release versions and migration requirements
rules.detail: Release artifacts must be traceable to source revision, schema/config changes and rollback compatibility.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Record release versions and migration requirements.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Record release versions and migration requirements.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-VERSIONING applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Versioning, Compatibility & Deprecation to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Versioning, Compatibility & Deprecation is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Versioning, Compatibility & Deprecation failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
